items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: My brother Tom, my oldest brother.

ctx.x: My brother Tom, my oldest brother. Mm-hmm. Tom's wife. These other people, I don't remember who they are. Now, this is Tom's wife right here.
I found Tom in the city directory, by the way. Tom Riddick. Thomas M. Riddick. Yeah. And he was working at Whirlines as a sales manager.
